name: @keeta-compute/cli
description: keeta-compute-agent: the agent binary the macOS app bundles, and the Linux CLI (a full node with its own wallet, or a helper paired with one).

scripts.build:mac: bun build src/main.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --external bufferutil --external utf-8-validate --outfile dist/darwin-arm64/keeta-compute-agent
scripts.build:linux-x64: bun build src/main.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-x64 --external bufferutil --external utf-8-validate --outfile dist/linux-x64/keeta-compute-agent
scripts.build:linux-arm64: bun build src/main.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-arm64 --external bufferutil --external utf-8-validate --outfile dist/linux-arm64/keeta-compute-agent
